products.name: DrumGirth
products.tagline: Kit generator, 16-pad sampler, loop cells and a filthy FX chain.
products.notes:
v0.2.0
- Renamed from Kit Maker to DrumGirth
- 16 pads, MPC-style 4x4 grid (C1 to D#2)
- Loop cells (pads 13-16), lock to session tempo
- Per-hit FX: Pitch, Decay, Filter, Drive, Pan, Verb send, Sidechain Duck, Volume
- Sidechain: pick a source pad, per-pad Duck amount
- Master: 3-band EQ, compressor, GIRTH, reverb, clipper, output
- Psychedelic skin, animated logo, reverb ripple graphic
